groups.name: wow.eventsourcing.storage-routing.aggregates
groups.description: Aggregate routes keyed by aggregate name in the current context or by fully qualified context.aggregate name.

properties.name: wow.eventsourcing.storage-routing.aggregates.*.event.storage
properties.description: EventStore backend type for this aggregate. Selects an existing backend type; it does not define backend connection settings.

properties.name: wow.eventsourcing.storage-routing.aggregates.*.event.binding
properties.description: Named EventStore binding for this aggregate. The binding must be provided by application code or auto-configuration.

properties.name: wow.eventsourcing.storage-routing.aggregates.*.snapshot.storage
properties.description: SnapshotStore backend type for this aggregate. Selects an existing backend type; it does not define backend connection settings.

properties.name: wow.eventsourcing.storage-routing.aggregates.*.snapshot.binding
properties.description: Named SnapshotStore binding for this aggregate. The binding must be provided by application code or auto-configuration.

properties.name: wow.query.gateway.max-depth
properties.description: Maximum nesting depth accepted in a query expression.

properties.name: wow.query.gateway.max-nodes
properties.description: Maximum total node count accepted in a query expression.

properties.name: wow.query.gateway.max-membership-items
properties.description: Maximum item count accepted by a membership predicate.

properties.name: wow.query.gateway.max-native-parameter-bytes
properties.description: Maximum serialized byte size accepted for native query parameters.

properties.name: wow.query.gateway.system-budget.timeout
properties.description: Optional system-wide timeout ceiling for each query invocation.

properties.name: wow.query.gateway.system-budget.max-results
properties.description: Optional system-wide maximum result count for each query invocation.

properties.name: wow.query.gateway.system-budget.max-cost
properties.description: Optional system-wide maximum deterministic planner cost: secured expression nodes plus projected fields plus stable sort fields.

properties.name: wow.query.gateway.enabled-capabilities
properties.description: Capability identifiers explicitly enabled for query planning.
